DetectEnv.description: Recognise the machine by an environment variable's value.

equals.description: The value that identifies the machine.
equals.title: Equals

DetectEnv.title: DetectEnv

DetectPath.description: Recognise the machine by a directory that exists only there, e.g. a site mount.
DetectPath.title: DetectPath

GpuNodesSpec.description: The GPU nodes a system offers, and how a job reaches them.

gpus_per_node.description: The number of GPUs on each GPU node.
gpus_per_node.title: Gpus Per Node

queue.description: The queue GPU jobs go to by default; one of the scheduler's queues.
queue.title: Queue

directives.description:
Extra directives for GPU jobs, e.g. `{-C: gpu}`; they replace the
scheduler's `directives` for GPU jobs.
directives.title: Directives

cores_per_node.description: The CPU cores on each GPU node.
cores_per_node.title: Cores Per Node

account_required.description: Whether the scheduler refuses a GPU job that names no account.
account_required.title: Account Required

request_gpus.description:
Whether a GPU job asks the scheduler for its GPUs (SLURM `--gpus-per-node`,
PBS `ngpus=`); false where the GPU nodes define no GPU resource and a job
reaches them through its queue alone.
request_gpus.title: Request Gpus

name.description: The name a job is submitted with.
name.title: Name

max_walltime.description: The queue's walltime limit, a quoted `HH:MM:SS` or `D-HH:MM:SS`.
max_walltime.title: Max Walltime

PBSSchedulerSpec.description: A PBS Professional or OpenPBS scheduler (`-l select=`); not Torque.

primary_queue.description: The queue a job goes to when it names none; one of `queues`.
primary_queue.title: Primary Queue

directives.description: Extra directives on every CPU job, as `flag: value`, e.g. `{-C: cpu}`.
directives.title: Directives

max_cpus_per_node.description: The CPUs per node used to lay out a job; omitted, the scheduler is asked.
max_cpus_per_node.title: Max Cpus Per Node

require.description: Which of `account` and `queue` a job must name.
require.title: Require

gpu_nodes.description: The system's GPU nodes; omitted when it has none.

queues.description: The queues jobs can be submitted to.
queues.title: Queues

ScratchSpec.description: Where the scratch file system is, on a machine that exports no `SCRATCH`-style variable.

match.description:
A glob for the scratch directory, with `~` and `{user}` expanded; the first
directory it matches, in sorted order, is used.
match.title: Match

subdir.description: A path appended to the matched directory, with `{user}` expanded; it need not exist.
subdir.title: Subdir

ScratchSpec.title: ScratchSpec

SlurmQueueSpec.description: A SLURM partition or QOS jobs can be submitted to.

name.description: The name a job is submitted with.
name.title: Name

kind.description: Whether `name` is a partition (`--partition`) or a QOS (`--qos`).
kind.title: Kind

query_name.description: The name the walltime query asks about; defaults to `name`.
query_name.title: Query Name

max_walltime.description:
Where the queue's walltime limit comes from: `sinfo`, `sacctmgr`, or a
fixed quoted `HH:MM:SS` or `D-HH:MM:SS`. Omitted, a partition asks `sinfo`
and a QOS asks `sacctmgr`.
max_walltime.title: Max Walltime

primary_queue.description: The queue a job goes to when it names none; one of `queues`.
primary_queue.title: Primary Queue

directives.description: Extra directives on every CPU job, as `flag: value`, e.g. `{-C: cpu}`.
directives.title: Directives

max_cpus_per_node.description: The CPUs per node used to lay out a job; omitted, the scheduler is asked.
max_cpus_per_node.title: Max Cpus Per Node

require.description: Which of `account` and `queue` a job must name.
require.title: Require

gpu_nodes.description: The system's GPU nodes; omitted when it has none.

queues.description: The partitions and QOS jobs can be submitted to.
queues.title: Queues

requires_task_distribution.description: Whether a job must state its nodes and tasks per node, not only its CPUs.
requires_task_distribution.title: Requires Task Distribution

upper_case_account.description:
Whether the site knows accounts only in upper case (TACC's submit filter
refuses `tg-abc123`, the lower-case name `sacctmgr` lists, and wants
`TG-ABC123`); C-Star then submits the account in upper case.
upper_case_account.title: Upper Case Account

ToolchainSpec.description: A compiler, MPI and module environment the system offers for one kind of run.

compiler.description: The compiler passed to the ROMS build: `gnu`, `intel` or `nvfortran`.
compiler.title: Compiler

mpi_prefix.description: The command that launches the model under MPI, e.g. `srun --kill-on-bad-exit=1`.
mpi_prefix.title: Mpi Prefix

gpu_arch.description: The NVIDIA compute capability of a GPU build, e.g. `cc80`; empty for CPU.
gpu_arch.title: Gpu Arch

link_flags.description:
Extra linker flags a GPU build appends after the MPI libraries; `${VAR}`
references are expanded when the build runs.
link_flags.title: Link Flags

modules.description:
The modules to load, in order, after `module reset`; each entry is the
argument of one `module load`. Empty leaves the user's modules alone.
modules.title: Modules

env.title: Env

description: One machine C-Star can run on, as its system file describes it.

schema_version.description: The version of the system file schema the file follows.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

name.description:
The system's name: lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`. It is the value
of `CSTAR_SYSTEM` that selects it, and the file's name without `.yaml`.
name.title: Name

detect.description:
How C-Star recognises the machine; any rule matching selects it. Not
needed when Lmod reports the system's name (`LMOD_SYSHOST` or
`LMOD_SYSTEM_NAME`).
detect.title: Detect

toolchains.description: The toolchains the system offers, by name; `cpu` is required.
toolchains.title: Toolchains

scheduler.description: The batch scheduler jobs are submitted to; omitted on a workstation.
scheduler.title: Scheduler

scratch.description: Where the scratch file system is, when no `SCRATCH`-style variable names it.

title: SystemSpec
